company: Department of Transport and Main Roads
title: Project Coordinator
apply_instructions: SEEK link out to Queensland Government Smart Jobs, reference QLD/703863/26, closes Monday 26 October 2026.
rationale: RoadTek Project Coordinator role coordinating crews, subcontractors and suppliers on road infrastructure, which matches Marc's site coordination target and his 2019 to 2020 site work coordinating 10 to 15 workers daily.
No degree or years of experience are listed as mandatory; Marc holds a BSCE and an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road and pavement design.
Regional Queensland base fits his stated availability for regional and FIFO work.
caution: Permanent Queensland public service role; eligibility of a Subclass 485 holder for permanent appointment is not stated in the advert and must be confirmed on the Smart Jobs information package. The role also mentors project staff and assists tendering and estimating, so it reads as a step above entry level. Winton is remote and would mean relocation.
gaps: Cert IV Project Management and Frontline Management desirable, not held
mandatory_unresolved: Permanent Queensland Government appointment: whether a temporary visa holder (Subclass 485 to December 2027) is eligible is not confirmed; check the Smart Jobs role description before applying
employer_line: RoadTek is the commercial construction business inside Queensland's Department of Transport and Main Roads, delivering road infrastructure across the state.
